title: HikeNation Archery Discovery
summary: A four-hour beginner archery workshop in Chaguaramas with instruction, equipment, practice, handbook and certificate for TT$375.
description: HikeNation's Archery Discovery is a four-hour beginner-friendly outdoor workshop covering archery safety, equipment handling, shooting fundamentals, accuracy and coached target practice. No prior experience is required. The TT$375 fee includes trained instructors, equipment and gear, an archery handbook and a certificate of participation.

price.label: TT$375 per person
price.terms: Includes the four-hour workshop, instructors, equipment and gear, handbook and certificate of participation.
